items.q: Do smart sub-meters require mechanical service shut-offs?
items.a: No. Our innovative riser meter units fit non-invasively directly over existing lines in individual crawlspaces. Setups complete cleanly in minutes without multi-tenant utility cutoffs.

items.q: How are communal/shared water costs calculated?
items.a: The central common-area pool (e.g. pool facilities, landscaping) is subtracted cleanly from main master meters first. Property groups allocate those structurally or pro-rate transparently.

items.q: How rapidly does HydroLedger detect continuous leak flows?
items.a: Our background alert pipelines check continuous draw signals. If flow doesn't touch zero over a rolling 10-minute cycle, warning dispatches instantly route to minimize damage risks.

items.q: Does HydroLedger handle security or resident privacy?
items.a: Yes. HydroLedger protects and stores resident portal identifiers behind standard encrypted channels. Operational data is kept secure strictly for consumption tracking.
